citation.verbatim: The press release issued August 9, 2024 was changed only to correct the record date and payment date for the dividends on its outstanding common stock. The dividend amounts have not changed. The dividends will be payable on August 30, 2024 to all stockholders of record as of the close of business on August 23, 2024, not payable on August 20, 2024 to all stockholders of record on August 12, 2024 as previously disclosed.

D1.decision: Process the mandatory dividend on the corrected record-date and pay-date terms using the projected 40000-share record-date position; do not use the superseded August 12 position.

actions.action: Book and verify the gross dividend receivable, then release payment processing on the corrected pay date

probe.derivation: Net cash cannot be determined because the store lacks the beneficial owner's tax-status documentation, such as Form W-8BEN or W-8BEN-E, and the applicable statutory or treaty withholding-rate determination.
